title: Simulate a token-bucket limiter
prompt: Implement solve(payload) for a token bucket. capacity>0, refill_per_second>=0, and optional initial_tokens (default capacity) define the policy. Requests are [{"time":seconds,"cost":tokens},...] with finite nonnegative time in nondecreasing order and strictly positive cost. Start at time 0. Before each request, refill by elapsed_time*refill_per_second, capped at capacity. Accept if tokens+1e-12>=cost, subtract the cost and clamp a tiny negative result to zero; otherwise deny without consuming tokens. Advance time even for denied requests. Return {"allowed":[booleans...],"remaining_tokens":tokens}. Do not refill beyond the final request time. Invalid capacity/refill/initial balance returns {"error":"invalid_policy"}; a negative or decreasing time or cost<=0 returns {"error":"invalid_request"}. Policy checks precede requests. Empty requests are valid. Do not mutate input. Token values use absolute tolerance 1e-9 and zero relative tolerance; booleans are exact.
